name: GLM 5.2 Fast
description: GLM 5.2 Fast is Baseten's faster-serving variant of GLM-5.2 with the same underlying weights and 1M-token context, optimized for higher-throughput inference.

details.name: availability_note
details.value: Baseten lists GLM-5.2 Fast as a separate Model API product; its public example uses the GLM-5.2 model slug on the shared endpoint.

sources.notes: Official Baseten library page identifies GLM-5.2 Fast as a faster-serving variant.
Official Baseten pricing lists $2.10 input, $0.21 cached input, and $6.60 output per 1M tokens.

verification.notes: Verified from Baseten's official model library and pricing page.
